mapper.select: SELECT id, session_id, role, content, context_text, user_id, created_at FROM ai_chat_messages WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND (user_id = #{userId} OR #{userId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL) ORDER BY created_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_chat_messages (session_id, role, content, context_text, user_id) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{contextText}, #{userId})
